name: Sedma
description: Sedma is a Czech trick-and-draw card game in which tricks are won by matching ranks; sevens act as wild cards. The game originated in Bohemia and became one of the most popular games in Czechoslovakia, and is played in partnerships or by 2–3 players.

overview.description: Sedma is a Czech trick-and-draw card game in which tricks are won by matching ranks; sevens act as wild cards. The game originated in Bohemia and became one of the most popular games in Czechoslovakia, and is played in partnerships or by 2–3 players.

history.origins: Country/Region of Origin: Bohemia (Czech Republic). Sedma is a Czech trick-and-draw game; it may have originated in Hungary or Poland and spread to Czechoslovakia in the mid-20th century, becoming one of the most popular games there. Related games exist across Central and Eastern Europe (Sedmice, Șeptică, Zsírozás, Hola).
timeline: Modern Era: Continues to be played worldwide
